title: Cinematic Landing — Asset Manifest
description: Records the user-supplied (or fallback) assets and the runtime branch the cinematic-landing template picks. Consumed by am-coder to choose implementation path from memory/02-scroll-film-canvas.md.

branch.description: A = video pipeline; B = video file; C = stills only; D = nothing yet.

pipeline.description: Optional. Set when branch = A. Names the extraction pipeline.

frames.description: Optional. Set when branch = A. Pre-extracted PNG frames.

video_url.description: Optional. Set when branch = B. Hotlinkable mp4/webm URL.

video_poster.description: Optional. Poster image for the video element.

still_urls.description: Optional. Set when branch = C. 5–6 hotlinkable JPG/PNG URLs.

subject.description: Free-text subject description for alt text.

hero_cutout.description: Transparent PNG of the foreground hero subject.

hero_aura.description: Soft-focus JPG of the same or similar subject.

ask_list.description: Optional. Set when branch = D. Concrete list of assets the user must supply.

parallax_intensity.description: How much the video container parallaxes on scroll (branch = B).

locale.description: BCP-47 locale code. Defaults to en-US.

reduced_motion_compliant.description: Whether the asset + implementation honors prefers-reduced-motion.
